title: Children's Online Safety Risk Calculator - Assess Digital Threats
metaDescription: Calculate your child's online safety risk level. Get personalized recommendations for parental controls, privacy settings, and digital protection.
description: Evaluate your child's current online safety level and get personalized recommendations for improving digital protection, privacy settings, and parental controls based on their age, activities, and existing safeguards.

formula: const ageRisk = childAge <= 8 ? 30: childAge <= 12 ? 20: 10; const deviceRisk = deviceAccess === 'unrestricted' ? 25: deviceAccess === 'limited' ? 15: deviceAccess === 'supervised' ? 5: 0; const controlRisk = parentalControls === 'none' ? 25: parentalControls === 'basic' ? 15: parentalControls === 'moderate' ? 8: 0; const socialRisk = socialMediaUse === 'extensive' ? 15: socialMediaUse === 'moderate' ? 8: socialMediaUse === 'minimal' ? 3: 0; const educationRisk = privacyEducation === 'none' ? 15: privacyEducation === 'basic' ? 10: privacyEducation === 'moderate' ? 5: 0; const timeRisk = screenTime > 4 ? 10: screenTime > 2 ? 5: 0; const riskScore = Math.min(100, ageRisk + deviceRisk + controlRisk + socialRisk + educationRisk + timeRisk); const riskGrade = riskScore <= 20 ? 'A': riskScore <= 35 ? 'B': riskScore <= 50 ? 'C': riskScore <= 70 ? 'D': 'F'; const priorityActions = (parentalControls === 'none' ? 1: 0) + (privacyEducation === 'none' ? 1: 0) + (deviceAccess === 'unrestricted' && childAge <= 12 ? 1: 0) + (socialMediaUse === 'extensive' && childAge <= 10 ? 1: 0); return { riskScore, riskGrade, priorityActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates online safety risk based on your child's age, device access level, current protective measures, online activities, privacy education received, and screen time. Higher risk scores indicate more potential vulnerabilities that should be addressed with appropriate safety measures.
tips: Start privacy education early - even young children can learn basic concepts about not sharing personal information
Use age-appropriate parental control tools and regularly update settings as your child grows
Consider using privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser for safer web browsing
Create a family media agreement that establishes clear rules for online behavior and screen time
Regularly review your child's online activities and friend lists on social platforms

interpretation.label: Low Risk (Grade A)
interpretation.description: Excellent safety measures in place. Continue monitoring and age-appropriate education.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk (Grade B)
interpretation.description: Good foundation with room for improvement. Consider upgrading some safety measures.

interpretation.label: Elevated Risk (Grade C)
interpretation.description: Several areas need attention. Implement additional parental controls and education.

interpretation.label: High Risk (Grade D)
interpretation.description: Significant vulnerabilities present. Immediate action needed to improve safety.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk (Grade F)
interpretation.description: Critical safety gaps. Comprehensive overhaul of online safety measures required.
